When the user uses full body, lies on the back (or side), and rotates the head to the side then the whole avatar will jitter a lot.

It seems to happen whenever the head rotates past a certain angle. Speed is completely irrelevant here. So if someone lies in a position where the head is close to certain angles then their avatar will continuously be all over the place.

This is a different behaviour from these other reports as in this case even slow movement of head triggers the behaviour and it applies to the entire body (including the head). It may be related though as all of them happen because of the IK:

comments.value:
I have tested this extensively. It doesn't matter what headset, or tracking. All jitter remotely when moving their head. Now someone has made a "fix" for it, but it requires every user to have unity knowledge as well as upload their own avatar as well as OSC understanding, so it's more of a "band-aid" than a fix. 

I've a friend who has a quest2 with haritora trackers

A friend with a vive with kinect tracking

A friend with a quest2 with kinect tracking

A friend with a index, with tundra trackers

a friend with index, vive AND tundra trackers

a friend with vive and vive trackers. 

All circumstances of tracking have this "jitter" to anyone else looking at them. 

the only way to "stop" it is to open a menu, such as 

"avatars" or "worlds" and then turn your head, and your body stops shaking.
this is still very much an ongoing issue much less than it once was but is still quite noticeable.
